reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent file and shell-output watchers that deliver new content to an agent session and provide watcher management tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化文件和 shell 输出监视器，在检测到新内容时唤醒智能体并支持管理监视器。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that persistently watches files and shell command output, wakes the agent when new content arrives, and manages active watchers.

capabilities: Watches append-only NDJSON files for new lines
Polls shell command output for changes
Wakes or queues messages for the owning agent
Lists and stops persistent session watchers
